message.content:
Based on my search, here are several free online tools and resources where you can get auto repair estimates:

## Top Free Online Auto Repair Estimate Tools

### 1. **RepairPal Estimator**
One of the most well-known and trusted sources for free repair estimates. You enter your zip code to get fair pricing based on your local area, with guaranteed prices for 30 days from RepairPal Certified shops.

### 2. **YourMechanic Estimates**
Provides **free instant auto repair and maintenance estimates** with detailed price breakdowns showing parts and labor costs separately. They also offer mobile mechanic services that come to your home or office.

### 3. **Otto (ottofixit.com)**
An **AI-powered tool** where you simply upload a photo of your car damage and get an instant repair estimate in under 30 seconds. It's completely free for vehicle owners and provides estimates for auto body damage including dents, scratches, collision repair, and paint damage. They also connect you with verified local shops.

### 4. **Instant Estimator**
A free online system that automatically assesses and costs cosmetic auto body and paint damage. You can submit online photos for more precise quotes and get connected to up to 3 authorized auto body repair facilities in your area.

### 5. **WhoCanFixMyCar (UK-based)**
Free car repair cost calculator where you select your vehicle make and model, enter your postcode, and get instant average repair costs with potential savings when booking through their platform.

### 6. **FreeAutoMechanic.com**
Offers free auto repair estimates upon request using professional automotive labor guide software. Covers US cars and trucks from 1990 to 2013. They provide labor time estimates that you can multiply by your local shop's hourly rate to get cost estimates.

### 7. **Mechlance**
A network of mobile mechanics offering free instant auto repair estimates. They claim you can save up to 50% on auto services with their escrow payment system.

### 8. **City of Stars Collision Center Online Estimator**
Free auto body repair estimates in minutes by filling out a form with your vehicle details and damage description. Technicians review and respond with estimates, often the same day.

## Tips for Using These Tools

- **Get multiple estimates** from different sources to compare pricing
- **Be specific** about your vehicle (year, make, model, trim) and the exact repair needed
- **Upload photos** when possible for more accurate body damage estimates
- **Check if the estimate includes** both parts and labor, as well as any additional fees
- **Verify shop credentials** if the tool connects you with local repair facilities

Sources:
